sources.note: Project description 2026-2027-2028: studies are in Serbian at the four state universities, academies and colleges of applied studies; one programme per scholarship

subject_rule: Limited to the institutions and faculties on the ministry's list (state universities of Belgrade, Art in Belgrade, Kragujevac, Nis and Novi Sad, vocational academies and Vojvodina colleges); the holder chooses a faculty and sits its entrance exam. The list is of faculties, not of individual degree programmes, except for the master programmes after three-year bachelor studies.

Recorded: bachelor 94 rows (73 faculties of the five universities plus 21 vocational institutions); master 89 rows (73 faculties plus 16 programmes named for master studies after three-year basic studies); doctorate 73 faculty rows; diploma 21 vocational-institution rows. These are the full lists in the source (94 institutions).

The ministry list does not say which of the faculties run doctoral studies or which master programmes each has; the doctoral and master faculty rows repeat the faculty list under the heading for those levels. Programmes inside a faculty are not named by the ministry (the project description says the choice is made after the Serbian course and an entrance exam).

The list names the State University of Novi Pazar only as a heading with the academies under it; no faculties are named for it, so none is recorded. The Faculty of Orthodox Theology is spelled 'Ortodox' in the first list and 'Orthodox' in the special note; the second spelling is used. Obvious typos in the scan (Tehnical, Tecnical, Novi Sada) are corrected; Serbian letters with accents (c, s, z) are written without them.
The first pass recorded the faculties as one row per university with the names joined in the detail; this pass records one row per faculty.
